title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm.
